Definition: to give (a daughter) away in marriage; hence (generally) to contract affinity by marriage
BiblicalUsage: 1) to become a son-in-law, make oneself a daughter's husband; 1a) (Qal) wife's father, wife's mother, father-in-law, mother-in- law (participle); 1b) (Hithpael) to make oneself a daughter's husband
